description: Compare NSW green slip (CTP, compulsory third party insurance) prices of all six NSW insurers - the regulated prices from SIRA's price check, the same as the greenslips.com.au calculator. Use it when someone needs a green slip: registration (rego) renewal due, buying a vehicle or bringing one to NSW, or checking whether they pay too much. Call it with the answers you have: until every needed answer is given it returns the remaining questions in order, with their options - ask the user those (never guess), then call again with all answers so far. When complete it returns each insurer's 12 and 6 month price with a link, and a link to the full result on greenslips.com.au.
